'''Adim''' is a thirteen year old boy, who has an uncle named [[Almen Bunt]].

==Appearance==
He has golden hair.

==Activities==
He is the son of [[Graeger]] and [[Alysa]] and has an older brother named [[Hahn]]. He pleads with his uncle Almen for help in saving his mother's apple orchard.

==Trivia==
*Adim is named after Adam Sampson, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
